info.name: Mushpoint API
info.description: Every Mushpoint API use case, in order. Set `baseUrl`, then either fill `supabaseUrl`, `supabaseAnonKey`, `email` and `password` and run "Sign in", or paste an access token into `token`. Run the folders top to bottom (the Collection Runner works); create requests store their ids for later ones. The two upload requests need a file picked first. Deleting the account is left out on purpose: it is `DELETE {{baseUrl}}/account` with the bearer token. Generated by `npm run postman` in `server/`.

variable.description: The project’s anon (public) key, for "Sign in" only.
A test account. Do not use a real account’s password in a shared collection.
Set by "Sign in", or paste a Supabase access token.
IANA zone used for "today", e.g. Europe/Berlin.

request.description: Talks to Supabase, not the API. Tokens expire after an hour; run this again on a 401.

item.name: 1. Profile and settings
item.description: The account’s username, avatar, theme and streak grace period.

request.description: Usernames are unique; `{{$timestamp}}` is Postman’s built-in current time.
Pick a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF of at most 5 MB in the `file` field.

item.name: 3. Goals and subgoals
item.description: Every PUT replaces the whole record: send every field, `null` to clear one.

{
  "categoryId": {{categoryId}},
  "title": "Run a half marathon",
  "description": "Train three times a week",
  "timeframe": "mid",
  "dueDate": "2027-06-01",
  "motivationText": "Feel strong",
  "motivationImagePath": null,

item.description: A task with a `recurrence` is a habit; marking it done on a day builds its streak.

request.description: `date: null` means today in `X-Timezone`; a `YYYY-MM-DD` marks a past day.
